description: We advise companies, investors and financial institutions on corporate and commercial matters in Bangladesh, including transactions, governance, mergers and acquisitions, private equity, financing, insurance and regulatory issues, with a focus on clear and commercially grounded advice.

We advise banks, financial institutions, investors and businesses on banking and finance matters, including structured finance, lending, project and asset finance, loan transactions and emerging FinTech matters.

We represent clients in complex commercial disputes in Bangladesh and internationally, covering litigation, arbitration, negotiation and mediation, supported by rigorous legal analysis and strategic judgment.

We help businesses and organisations navigate Bangladesh's regulatory environment and engage with key governmental authorities, covering compliance, investment, labour, competition, environmental, tax and corporate registration matters.

description: We advise employers on employment matters, including cessation, labour laws, employment regulations, service rules, workplace conduct and workforce restructuring, helping organisations manage employment decisions with clarity and compliance.

We advise businesses on intellectual property, technology and digital matters, including IP rights, data protection, cyber law, digital infrastructure, telecommunications and emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence.
